conclusion.canonical_formulation: Closed-ball diameter-normalized positive finite existing density implies standard Lipschitz-image rectifiability.

kernel_replay.meaning: Replays safe logical declarations through Lean kernel addDeclCore, including constructor/recursor consistency checks. The fresh pass reconstructs the Main import environment from empty.
limits: Uses the same Lean kernel, not a separately implemented verifier.
Lean replay skips unsafe and partial executable declarations.
Replay accepts declared axioms: the separate dependency audit enforces the permitted axioms for Preiss.preiss.
Successful replay of companion modules does not remove their tracked sorryAx dependencies.

checks: Finite Lipschitz constants and inherited subtype metric; countability and Hausdorff absolute continuity prevent empty-domain/singular-measure loopholes.
Borel sigma-finite carrier is constructed; ambient Hausdorff sigma-finiteness is not assumed.
Dimension zero requires countable atomic concentration; full-measure carrier differs correctly from topological support.
Positive-dimensional Dirac and diffuse zero-dimensional examples fail the appropriate hypotheses/conclusions.
m > n forces zero measure; m = n and n = 0 retained. No hidden finite-total-mass or probability assumption.

semantic_reviews.area: Tangents, dimension reduction, first crossing, rigidity

Ambient-dimension induction retains measure dimension and actual scaling-orbit relations.

Conical energy bridges open/closed balls through sphere-nullity.

Actual nonzero tangent extraction prevents vacuous universal flatness.

Projection-nullness uses measurable domain covers and outer-measure bounds for arbitrary images.

Maximal rectifiable part is constructed; finite-measure cancellation and null remainder are justified.
